title: EST Preboard 5
subject: Electronics Systems and Technologies
description: 99-card EST Preboard 5 reviewer with solutions and answer explanations. The source PDF skips Question 34.

questions.solution: The components are 50 Hz and 150 Hz because 100π=2π(50) and 300π=2π(150). Nyquist requires at least twice the highest frequency: 2(150)=300 Hz. 150 and 200 Hz are too low; 400 Hz works but is not the minimum.
IP provides logical addressing and routing across interconnected networks. Reliable delivery and retransmission are transport-layer concerns, while formatting/display belongs to upper layers.

The source slide shows only the character “a” as the question stem. That appears to indicate option A, which is 64, but the item is malformed in the PDF and should be verified against the original source.

A normally closed loop is continuous while the door is closed. Opening the door or cutting the wire breaks the loop, so the panel detects the fault/alarm condition. The other options do not describe fail-safe NC operation.
For phase modulation, the modulation index equals the maximum phase deviation in radians. Thus β=2.5. The other values do not match the stated phase deviation.
A short-circuited lossless line that is exactly λ/4 long transforms a short into an open circuit, so its input impedance is ideally infinite. It is not simply reactive and it does not remain a short.
ATM uses fixed 53-byte cells. Ethernet and X.25 use variable-length frames/packets, while frame relay also does not use fixed 53-byte cells.
Binary entropy is H=−0.25log2(0.25)−0.75log2(0.75)≈0.811 bit/symbol. The other values do not satisfy the entropy formula.
VSWR=(1+|Γ|)/(1−|Γ|)=1.2/0.8=1.5. The other choices come from using the reflection coefficient directly or the wrong formula.

The IF amplifier provides most of the receiver’s gain and selectivity at a fixed intermediate frequency. It does not generate the local oscillator, directly drive the speaker, or convert analog to digital.
A thermocouple operates on the Seebeck effect, producing a small voltage from a temperature difference between dissimilar metals. RTDs and thermistors are resistance-based sensors.
A bus topology uses one shared backbone cable with nodes tapped along it. Ring, star, and mesh have different physical interconnections.
UDP is preferred for real-time video when low latency matters more than perfect delivery because it avoids connection setup and retransmission delays. TCP prioritizes reliable delivery.
With high-side injection, fLO=fRF+fIF=1200+455=1655 kHz. The lower numerical choices use subtraction or ignore the IF.
Shannon capacity C=B log2(1+S/N). With B=4 kHz and S/N=10^(15/10)=31.62, C≈4k·log2(32.62)≈20.1 kbps, closest to 20.2 kbps.
Velocity factor=v/c=(2×10^8)/(3×10^8)=0.667≈0.67. The other values do not match the ratio.
256 quantization levels require log2(256)=8 bits/sample. At 8 ksample/s, bit rate=8×8 kHz=64 kbps.
Γ=(ZL−Z0)/(ZL+Z0)=(50−75)/(50+75)=−25/125=−0.20. The sign is negative because the load impedance is lower than Z0.
White noise has an approximately flat power spectral density over frequency. Shot, pink, and transit-time noise do not have the same flat-spectrum definition.
Entropy is the average information content, or uncertainty, of a discrete information source. It is not simply data rate, harmonic power, or channel bandwidth.
y[2]=x[2]−0.5x[1]=6−0.5(4)=4. The other answers come from using the wrong sample indices or sign.
Hartley’s law states that the amount of information that can be transmitted is proportional to bandwidth and transmission time. The other parameter pairs are not Hartley’s relationship.

VLANs logically divide one physical switched network into separate broadcast domains, improving segmentation and reducing unnecessary broadcasts. They do not eliminate IP addressing or force one broadcast domain per physical switch.
QAM varies both carrier amplitude and phase to represent symbols. FSK varies frequency, PSK varies phase, and BPSK is a two-phase special case.
Coherent BPSK and QPSK have the same theoretical BER versus Eb/N0 because QPSK can be viewed as two orthogonal BPSK channels. The other claims about always better or infinitely high BER are false.
Asymmetric encryption uses a mathematically related key pair, typically a public key and a private key. It does not use only one shared key or no keys.

CDMA users share the same spectrum, so received powers must be controlled to prevent the near-far problem. Encryption and battery protection are not the primary reason for tight closed-loop power control.
Half-duplex allows communication in both directions, but only one side transmits at a time. Full-duplex allows simultaneous transmission; simplex is one-way only.
Friis: Ftotal=F1+(F2−1)/G1=2+(11−1)/10=3 because 10 dB gain=10 linear. The other values ignore the first-stage gain or use dB directly.
SSB-SC transmits only one sideband and suppresses the carrier, cutting bandwidth roughly in half and saving power compared with DSB-FC.
For 0–5 V and 8 bits, one LSB≈5/256=19.53 mV. Maximum quantization error is ±0.5 LSB≈9.77 mV.
Approximate parabolic HPBW≈70λ/D. At 4 GHz, λ=0.075 m, so HPBW≈70(0.075)/3=1.75°.
North American ISDN PRI uses 23 bearer channels plus 1 D signaling channel. The other channel counts are not the standard T1-based PRI structure.

At the Data Link layer, LANs commonly use Ethernet/MAC framing, while WAN links may use point-to-point protocols such as PPP or HDLC. The other statements misplace addressing or describe outdated access methods.
MUF is the highest frequency that can be returned to Earth by the ionosphere for a particular path and conditions. It is not the minimum usable frequency or an antenna damage limit.
Traditional telecom audio calculations commonly use 600 Ω as the reference impedance associated with dBm power levels. 50 Ω and 75 Ω are common RF/coax values.
Asynchronous serial transmission uses start bits so the receiver can resynchronize its sampling clock for each character. It does not require a shared dedicated clock or atomic clocks.
20 W≈43 dBm. After 3 dB feedline loss: 40 dBm. Add 10 dBi antenna gain: 50 dBm EIRP, equivalent to 100 W.
HDLC inserts a 0 after any run of five consecutive 1s. For six consecutive 1s, the stuffed output is 1111101. The other strings do not follow the five-ones stuffing rule.

PCM represents samples digitally, so repeaters can regenerate clean logic levels instead of amplifying accumulated analog noise. PCM still requires sampling and generally uses more bandwidth than PAM.
HPBW is the angular separation between the two −3 dB points of the main lobe, where power density is half the maximum. First-null beamwidth uses the nulls, not the half-power points.
PPM represents the sample amplitude by shifting the pulse position in time while keeping pulse width essentially constant. PAM changes amplitude and PWM changes width.
QPSK carries 2 bits/symbol. At 2400 baud, bit rate=2400×2=4800 bps.
ISDN BRI has 2B+D: 64+64+16=144 kbps of channel payload. 128 kbps counts only the two B channels.
CSMA/CD detects a collision, sends a jam signal, waits a random backoff interval, then retries. Fixed time slots and token permission belong to other MAC methods.

A gateway can translate between dissimilar protocol architectures, often operating above the network layer. A standard router mainly forwards packets between networks using compatible network-layer protocols.
Lowering IF makes channel selectivity easier because the required filter Q is lower, but it reduces image separation (2fIF), worsening image rejection.
A T1 frame has 24 channels×8 bits=192 payload bits plus 1 framing bit, for 193 bits total.

A quarter-wave vertical monopole over a ground plane is approximately omnidirectional in azimuth, with strongest radiation near the horizon. It is not a narrow upward beam or a two-lobed horizontal pattern.
At 150 MHz, λ=c/f=2 m. A physical half-wave length is (λ/2)(0.95)=1×0.95=0.95 m.
Four-wire circuits provide separate transmit and receive pairs, supporting full-duplex operation and easier amplification/repeater design. They do not inherently eliminate noise.
An isotropic radiator is the reference antenna, defined as 0 dBi gain. Positive or negative dBi values imply gain relative to isotropic.
Reliable end-to-end delivery and flow control are transport-layer functions, handled by protocols such as TCP. The Data Link layer is only hop-to-hop.
ΔR=GF·ε·R=2(500×10⁻6)(120)=0.12 Ω. The other values result from missing the microstrain conversion or gauge factor.
μ-law companding uses finer effective quantization for small-amplitude signals and coarser steps for large amplitudes, improving low-level signal-to-quantization-noise ratio.
Noise figure in dB equals SNRin(dB)−SNRout(dB)=40−34=6 dB.
Directivity and beamwidth are generally inversely related: a narrower main beam concentrates radiation more strongly and therefore usually means higher directivity.
An FIR filter has no recursive feedback path, so with bounded coefficients it is inherently BIBO stable. IIR filters can become unstable because of poles/feedback.
For FM, the carrier amplitude is proportional to J0(β). β≈2.405 is the first zero; β=2.47 is close, so the carrier component is nearly nulled.
Waveguide cutoff is the minimum frequency at which a given propagation mode can travel. Below cutoff, fields decay exponentially rather than propagate.
For sinusoidal AM, Ptotal=Pc(1+m²/2)=50(1+1/2)=75 kW at m=1.
A DSSS transmitter multiplies the data by a much faster pseudo-random chip sequence, spreading energy over a wider bandwidth and improving resistance to narrowband interference/jamming.
For a rational causal discrete-time system, the ROC lies outside the outermost pole. Stability requires the unit circle to lie in the ROC, which means all poles must be inside the unit circle.
AM total power is proportional to antenna current squared. (11.5/10)²=1+m²/2, giving m≈0.803≈0.80.
A star topology depends on its central hub/switch. If that central device fails, communication for the attached nodes can fail, whereas mesh has multiple alternate paths.
For dominant TE10 mode, fc=c/(2a)=3×10^8/[2(0.025)]=6 GHz.
64-QAM carries log2(64)=6 bits/symbol. Symbol rate=10 Mbps/6≈1.67 Mbaud, giving an ideal Nyquist bandwidth of about 1.67 MHz.
H(z)=z/(z−1.5) has a pole at z=1.5 outside the unit circle. For a causal realization the impulse/step terms grow as 1.5^n, so the step response diverges.
Carson’s rule: BW≈2(Δf+fm)=2(50+10)=120 kHz.
A modem modulates computer digital data into analog waveforms suitable for transmission over traditional telephone channels, and demodulates received signals.
The FCS is a CRC-derived value computed from frame contents. The receiver recomputes it to detect transmission errors. It is not a MAC address or frame-start delimiter.
Total AM sideband power=Pc m²/2=0.125Pc for m=0.5. Total power=1.125Pc, so sideband fraction=0.125/1.125≈11.11%.
Linear convolution of [1,2] and [1,−1] is [1, 2−1, −2]=[1,1,−2].

Low-frequency/baseband wireless radiation would require impractically large antennas because efficient antenna dimensions scale with wavelength. Modulation translates the information to a practical RF carrier.
In a Yagi-Uda array, directors are typically slightly shorter than the driven element, often by around 5%, while reflectors are slightly longer.
CRC treats the bit block as a polynomial, divides it by a generator polynomial using modulo-2 arithmetic, and appends the remainder to the transmitted block.
A PLC normally reads physical inputs into the input image during the scan. A change that occurs while the user program is executing is generally recognized on the next scan cycle.
HF skywave propagation relies primarily on the ionosphere, which can refract/return HF energy to Earth for long-distance communication.
An energy signal has finite nonzero total energy and zero average power over infinite time. Power signals instead have finite nonzero average power and infinite energy.
A matching stub supplies a controllable reactive susceptance/reactance that cancels the unwanted reactive part of the load, creating an impedance match.
When ZL=Z0, Γ=0, so all incident power is absorbed by the load, no power is reflected, and VSWR=1.
For binary signaling, each symbol represents exactly one bit, so bit rate equals baud rate. Multilevel signaling carries more than one bit per symbol.
For 4–20 mA mapped linearly to 0–200°C, 12 mA is halfway through the 16 mA span, so temperature=100°C.
Parseval’s theorem states that the total signal energy computed in time domain equals the total energy computed in frequency domain.
Sampling 4 kHz at 6 kHz folds the component to |4−6|=2 kHz inside the principal Nyquist band 0–3 kHz.
Thermal-noise RMS voltage is vn=√(4kTRB). With 50 Ω, 290 K, and 1 MHz, vn≈0.89 µV.
The ladder-logic symbol —| |— is a normally open contact. A coil is usually drawn as —( )—, while a normally closed contact has a slash.
Ideal PCM dynamic range improves by about 6.02 dB per added bit. Going from 8 to 12 bits adds 4 bits, so the increase is about 24 dB.
Ground-wave attenuation increases strongly with frequency, so useful ground-wave range generally decreases as operation moves upward through HF toward VHF.
The horizontal center axis of the Smith Chart corresponds to purely resistive normalized impedances, where reactance is zero.
Atmospheric ducting forms a refractive-index layer that acts like a dielectric waveguide, allowing VHF/UHF signals to travel beyond the normal radio horizon.
Te=T0(F−1). A 3 dB noise figure gives F≈2, so Te≈290(1)=290 K.

An HMI gives operators graphical displays, alarms, status information, and controls for interacting with an industrial process. It is not itself the valve mechanism or the communication encryption layer.
WDM carries multiple optical channels on different wavelengths through the same fiber. FDM is the broader frequency-domain concept, but WDM is the standard fiber-optic technique.
Power density S=EIRP/(4πr²)=100/[4π(5000)²]≈3.18×10⁻7 W/m².
A DC component corresponds to z=1. Placing a zero at z=1 forces H(1)=0, rejecting DC while allowing higher-frequency content to pass.

Granular noise in delta modulation is most prominent when the input is flat or changes very slowly compared with the step size, causing the staircase output to hunt/oscillate around the signal. Rapid changes instead cause slope-overload distortion.
